_doc: The human UI's session auth — every number the app_api/ package uses. Separate from config/signal_engine.json etc. by concern, same loader shape.

platform._doc: The platform console (platform_admin/). Roles a user may hold in users.platform_role, and the thresholds behind the attention list.

alerts._doc: platform_admin/alerts.py. The topic itself comes from the ALERT_SNS_TOPIC_ARN environment variable.

onboarding._doc: platform_admin/onboarding.py — the console's tenant onboarding flow. files: what the upload step offers, in order; expected files are the ones the flow asks for before it moves on, the rest are optional. max_csv_bytes bounds one file sent through the console (larger loads go through scripts/onboard_tenant.py). modes: process_data modes offered, the first is the default. max_problems caps the pre-flight problems returned.

files.label: Accounts
files.what: One row per account: name, revenue, status, renewal.

files.label: KPI measurements
files.what: Dated KPI values per account; these drive the health scores.

files.label: Signals
files.what: Dated notes, tickets and call summaries per account.

files.label: Outcomes
files.what: Dated business results per account (loss, expansion, renewal), with amounts.

files.label: Stakeholders
files.what: People at each account and their roles.

files.label: Decisions
files.what: Dated decisions and interventions per account.
